items.title: Elon Musk takes aim at Delta for refusing to use Starlink for Wi-Fi
items.summary: In a post on X this week, SpaceX (SPCX) founder and CEO Elon Musk took aim at Delta Air Lines (DAL) for not using Starlink to offer internet access on its flights. The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley break down the story.

items.title: OpenAI's Dots connect to 4,000 apps and never sleep
items.summary: OpenAI just unveiled Dots: an always-on AI assistant with 4,000+ tools that might just be the closest thing yet to Tony Stark's "Jarvis." In The Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen explains how Dots stacks up against Meta's Muse and Elon Musk's Grok Bot, and how OpenAI's other Dev Day launches fit together with the new, 24/7 agent. If you want to know where AI assistants are headed, start here.

items.title: What Should Costco Stock Holders Take From Its Fiscal Fourth Quarter?
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) stock rose 2.9% in the first session after its Q4 FY2026 report. The shares trade at 46.4 times earnings, more than twice the S&P 500's 21.9, so holders are counting on growth that keeps coming. What should a Costco holder take from a quarter that beat estimates and lifted the stock, yet left questions about whether its price cuts are driving more sales.

items.title: Amazon Target Lifted as Rosenblatt Says AI Agents Won’t Disrupt Business Model
items.summary: Wall Street has grown increasingly nervous that AI shopping agents could hollow out Amazon's retail media empire, and the stock has the bruises to prove it. Rosenblatt just raised its price target and laid out a pointed case for why that fear is misreading what the data actually shows.

items.title: The AI Revolution Could Be Microsoft’s Next Trillion-Dollar Opportunity
items.summary: Azure's explosive backlog and Copilot's paid seat growth have bulls eyeing targets near $700, but a capex surge that outpaced free cash flow by a wide margin could threaten the entire AI thesis before it pays off.
